jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(4)(A) inventory: Mettawee School District, a union elementary district in the Bennington-Rutland Supervisory Union (member towns: Pawlet, Rupert). Operates PK-6; tuitions grades 7-12.

sources.note: Mettawee School District Articles of Agreement, codified at 16 V.S.A. Appendix ch. 67. Art. 9: a seven-person board apportioned by population (one member per 281 residents; 1990 census: Pawlet 5, Rupert 2), adjusted each decennial census; "Union School Directors shall be elected by the registered voters of the member district which they represent" -- town-only electorates. Art. 10: three-year terms.

Town of Pawlet (official): Certificate of Votes, March 3, 2026 -- "Mettawee School Director, 3 years -- Julie Mach, 268" (re-elected; term to March 2029). The Town Report 2026 officials list ("Mettawee School District Directors," as of March 2025) names Scott McChesney (expires March 2028; his March 4, 2025 election is certified at 272 votes), Cori Rail (2027) and Amerigo (Rico) Balzano (2027). The district's 2026 warning offered only the one Pawlet seat.

board.post_note: MODEL: one post per member town (proportional, town-only electorates, 16 V.S.A. App. ch. 67 Art. 9). Rupert's two directors are unnamed in any fetched official source (missing: the Town of Rupert town report/officials list or the Mettawee district annual report), and only four Pawlet directors are observed seated against the articles' five -- the fifth seat is vacant or was removed by a decennial adjustment; no fetched document says which.
